code.gateway_unreachable: The gateway is not answering, so it cannot be asked.
code.login_expired: This sign-in took too long and has expired.
code.management_key_missing: The gateway has no management key on this box, so its accounts cannot be reached.
code.state_not_settled: The machine is still applying its configuration.
code.unknown_account: That account is no longer on this box.

code.user_unknown: The user is not applied on this machine yet.
ui.ai.access_hint: Keys handed to clients are named after the client. Generate one by hand for a machine no client runs on.
ui.ai.account_delete_body: The account stops serving at once. Machines keep working through whatever other keys and accounts remain.
ui.ai.accounts_empty_hint: Sign in once and every machine shares it.
ui.ai.accounts_hint: Accounts and API keys serve the same models as one pool; the gateway picks between them.
ui.ai.base_url_hint: Leave empty for the service's default; set it for a relay. Match the kind to the protocol the endpoint speaks, not to whose models are behind it: DeepSeek's /anthropic endpoint is Anthropic.
ui.ai.device_hint: Open this address and enter the code there.
ui.ai.fresh_key_hint: Paste it into the tool beside the endpoint above.
ui.ai.gateway_port_hint: The TCP port the gateway answers on.
ui.ai.journal_unavailable: The journal is not readable yet.
ui.ai.key_name_placeholder: what will use it, e.g. laptop
ui.ai.keys_empty_hint: Generate one for a machine that has no agent on it.
ui.ai.models_hint: One per line, real name first; add = alias when tools should see a different name. Devices are told to ask for the first one.
ui.ai.needs_token: Needs a token before it can serve
ui.ai.no_login_kinds: This gateway offers no subscription sign-in.
ui.ai.not_installed: The AI gateway is not installed
ui.ai.not_installed_hint: The hub package carries it; run `sudo nhub apply` to put it back.
ui.ai.paste_placeholder: paste the address bar or the code here
ui.ai.port_apply_hint: Restarts the gateway on the new port.
ui.ai.port_apply_warning: Every machine pointed at the old port stops reaching the gateway until its endpoint is changed too.
ui.ai.provider_delete_body: The provider is removed from this box; the token it was keyed with stays stored.
ui.ai.providers_apply_hint: Saves the serving order and which providers are enabled, then reloads the gateway.
ui.ai.providers_apply_stale_hint: The gateway is serving an older configuration; applying reloads it.
ui.ai.providers_apply_warning: The gateway restarts, and requests in flight fail.
ui.ai.providers_empty_hint: Add an API endpoint and token once, instead of pasting it into every machine.
ui.ai.providers_hint: The endpoints the gateway forwards to, each keyed with a stored token. The list is the serving order: the first enabled provider answers first.
ui.ai.redirect_hint: Open this address and sign in. The browser lands on a page that does not load; its address goes below.
ui.ai.revoke_body: Whatever is using this key stops reaching the gateway at once, and needs a new one to get back in.
ui.ai.revoke_client_body: {client} stops reaching the gateway at once and is handed a new key.
ui.ai.sign_in_pick_hint: Which subscription this box signs in to.
ui.ai.subtitle: One endpoint for every machine's AI tools; which provider answers is switched here.
ui.ai.title: AI
ui.ai.token_hint: The stored token this endpoint is keyed with.
ui.ai.usage_unavailable_hint: The gateway is not reporting usage on this box yet.
ui.containers.autostart_hint: Whether this container starts with the box. Off, it stays declared and starts only when asked.
ui.containers.command_hint: Empty uses the image's command; base images need a long-running one.
ui.containers.containers_apply_hint: First starts pull the image, which can take a while.
ui.containers.containers_apply_warning: Edited containers will be recreated, and files outside volumes will be lost.
ui.containers.declared_hint: Each becomes a systemd unit on the default network.
ui.containers.live_empty: No containers exist yet. Declared ones appear here after Apply.
ui.containers.mirrors_apply_hint: Takes effect on the next pull; nothing restarts.
ui.containers.name: Name
ui.containers.not_installed: The container engine is not installed on this machine. Enable podman for it above.
ui.containers.shell_failed: The shell failed (exit code {code}). What it printed stays until you close.
ui.containers.tags_empty: No tags found. Type one, e.g. :latest.
ui.containers.title: Containers
ui.gitea.access_hint: What must agree with the hub. Repositories, accounts and everything else are managed in Gitea itself.
ui.gitea.admin_create_not_ready: Create the first administrator. Start the service first.
ui.gitea.admin_managed: Accounts and repositories are managed in Gitea; reset the password here.
ui.gitea.not_installed: Gitea is not installed on this machine.
ui.gitea.registration_hint: Whether visitors can create their own accounts.
ui.gitea.root_url_hint: Written into clone addresses. Leave empty to derive from the machine's address.
ui.list.empty: No entries; everything goes through the proxy.
ui.password.panel_hint: At least {count} characters, and better for mixing letters, numbers and symbols.
ui.password.shortfall_length: Too short: {count} characters at the very least.
ui.password.vault_hint: At least {count} characters, mixing lowercase, uppercase, digits and symbols.
ui.samba.share_read_only_hint: Whether writing is refused for everyone, whoever they are.
ui.samba.share_users_all: None picked: every user may use it.
ui.samba.share_users_none: Every user; none are configured yet.
ui.samba.share_users_picked: Only the picked users may use it.
ui.samba.shares_apply_hint: Saves shares and reloads the server.
ui.samba.users_apply_hint: Creates accounts, sets staged passwords, revokes removed ones.
ui.samba.users_hint: Accounts that may connect. Adding stages name and password together; replacing a password is removing the user and adding it again.
ui.usage.grid_empty_hint: Cells fill in as machines talk to the gateway.
ui.usage.keys_empty_hint: A key shows up here once its machine talks to the gateway.
ui.usage.providers_empty_hint: Rows appear once the gateway forwards a request.
ui.usage.title: AI usage
ui.usage.unavailable_hint: The gateway is not reporting usage on this box yet.
ui.zfs.dataset_destroy_body: The dataset and every file on it are removed from the pool. There is no snapshot to return to unless one was taken.

ui.zfs.destroy_warning: Destroying {name} erases every dataset on it. Type the pool name to continue.
ui.zfs.expand_note: The new vdev joins the pool permanently; it cannot be removed later.
ui.zfs.force_generic: zpool wants explicit confirmation for this combination. Add anyway?
ui.zfs.force_in_use: A chosen disk still carries traces of an earlier pool or filesystem; adding will overwrite them. Add anyway?
ui.zfs.force_mismatched: This layout does not match the pool's existing vdevs: the pool would only be as safe as its weakest vdev. Add anyway?
ui.zfs.no_spare_build: No spare disks to build from
ui.zfs.no_spare_grow: No spare disks to grow with
ui.zfs.no_spare_replace: No spare disk to replace with
ui.zfs.not_installed: The ZFS tools are not installed
ui.zfs.not_installed_hint: Enable the zfs module for this machine above.
ui.zfs.pools_empty_hint: Pick spare disks and create one, or plug in disks that already hold a pool.
ui.zfs.record_hint: Small records suit databases and VM images; large ones suit media and archives.
ui.zfs.share_lead: Exports {mountpoint} over SMB, read-write for the chosen users.
ui.zfs.share_users_all: None picked: every user may use it, future ones included.
ui.zfs.topology_empty: no pools and no spare disks

ui.zfs.vdev_single: Striped over {count}: {usable} usable, no disk may fail.
